summary: Iter62 — GPU Quota Alert banner + Engines in Creation (image/video/music/upscale). Backend: 10/10 pytest green in /app/backend/tests/test_quota_and_creations_iter62.py. Covered: (1) GET /api/gpu-admin/aws returns quota=8, quota_needed=4, quota_approved_at set, quota_alert=true while mode='on_demand' and quota_alert_dismissed=false; POST /api/gpu-admin/aws/quota/dismiss returns {dismissed:true} and subsequent overview shows quota_alert=false; restoring quota_alert_dismissed=false in Mongo re-arms the banner. (2) With global governance ['create:image','create:video','create:music'], anonymous POST /api/generate/jobs, /api/video, /api/music, /api/generate, /api/upscale/jobs ALL return 403 with detail starting 'Blocked by Frasberg engine rules' — governance was reset to [] after the test. (3) GET /api/engines/creations with admin JWT returns kinds.image/video/music with checked/blocked counters and a recent list; checked and blocked both increase after the blocked calls; with X-Frasberg-Key header it correctly returns 403 'Admins only'. (4) Final POST /api/gpu-admin/aws/quota/check (run LAST) refreshed the real AWS quota — quota becomes 0.0, quota_approved_at=null, quota_alert=false, removing the simulation as expected. Frontend /status as admin: quota-banner mounts with text 'AWS approved your GPU limit · Quota is now 8 vCPU (needs 4). Switch to always-on for instant clips on the g5.xlarge · about $734/mo.' and buttons quota-banner-always-on (enabled, NOT clicked per instructions) and quota-banner-dismiss (clicked → banner removed from DOM). engine-creations panel renders engine-creations-image/video/music counters (5/2/3 live after tests). Regression: /api/engines/* runtime endpoints still work (iter61 suite remains valid). Final env state: governance global=[] owner=[]; aws_gpu simulation removed via quota/check (real AWS quota=0).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py now 2138 lines (was 2093) — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. The /api/gpu-admin/aws/quota/{check,dismiss} handlers + /api/engines/creations could move into routers/gpu_admin.py and routers/engines.py (iter61 recommendation still stands).

aws_gpu.overview() calls check_quota() every time quota<need. In the normal 'approved' path (quota>=need) this is skipped, so the Mongo simulation sticks — good. However if an admin happens to set an instance_type whose need>8 after approval, overview() will silently overwrite the simulated approval. Not a bug for current config but worth a comment.
/api/engines/creations stats endpoint has no explicit cap on 'recent' list length — a long-running pod could balloon the response. engine_systems.creation_stats() should slice (e.g. [-50:]).
QuotaBanner relies on polling /api/gpu-admin/aws from the parent EngineStatus; there is no WebSocket/SSE push, so admin only sees approval after they visit /status. Minor product nit, not a bug.

Blocked creation endpoints (/api/generate, /api/generate/jobs, /api/video, /api/music, /api/upscale, /api/upscale/jobs, /api/edit, /api/edit/jobs, /api/remove-bg, /api/remove-bg/jobs) all funnel through creation_check() → engine_systems.check_creation() → unified 403 'Blocked by Frasberg engine rules: …'. Consistent and audit-friendly.
